items.title: Analyst says 'GTA VI' could sell 30M copies by March, maybe December
items.summary: Michael Pachter, Wedbush Securities Managing Director, Strategic Planning, joins Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa to discuss how soon "Grand Theft Auto VI" could sell 30 million copies, pass $1 billion in sales, and clear its roughly $2 billion development cost.

items.title: 'GTA VI' release: One YF producer details how much he's spent so far
